description: This file is a web page containing HTML and embedded JavaScript to demonstrate various drag-and-drop widget behaviors using the Isomorphic SmartClient framework. It includes setup code for draggable canvases with different drag appearances, form controls for user interaction, and event handling scripts.

methods.name: setIntersectStyles
methods.description: Switches the drag intersection style between 'rect' and 'mouse' for multiple canvases based on a checkbox toggle. Updates contents to reflect current mode.

methods.name: initializeForm
methods.description: Initializes the form controls' default states when the page loads.
